content: Please feel free to make a copy of this airship info sheet to track your airship inventory and upgrades.

Air Frames are available for purchase in <#851195659985485844> 
New models of airships have arrived in port. There are 5 common air frames available to choose from. These can be customized extensively. They are Pixie, Raven, Harpy, Pegasus, and Dragon. The plans are also freely available for crafting.

Skiff Class: HD d2, HP20, AC 8 (Cost: Free)
Stations: 1. Helm, 2. Engines (2 total stations)

Pixie Class: HD d4, HP40, AC 16, (Cost: 3000 gp, Zephyrous quality)
Stations: 1. Helm, 2. Engines, 3. Open, 4. Open (4 total stations)
Typical Size: 10-30ft long

Raven Class: HD d6, HP60, AC 14, (Cost: 6000 gp, Zephyrous quality)
Stations: 1. Helm, 2. Engines, 3. Open, 4. Open, 5 Open, 6. Open (6 total stations)
Typical Size: 20-50ft long

Harpy Class: HD d8, HP80, AC 12, (Cost: 12,000 gp, Zephyrous quality)
Stations: 1. Helm, 2. Engines, 3. Open, 4. Open, 5 Open, 6. Open, 7 Open, 8. Open (8 total stations)
Typical Size: 40-80ft long

Pegasus Class: HD d10, HP100, AC 10, (Cost: 20,000 gp, Zephyrous quality)
Stations: 1. Helm, 2. Engines, 3. Open, 4. Open, 5 Open, 6. Open, 7 Open, 8. Open, 9. Open, 10. Open (10 total stations)
Typical Size: 80-100ft long

Dragon Class: HD d12, HP120, AC 8, (Cost: 30,000 gp, Zephyrous quality)
Stations: 1. Helm, 2. Engines, 3. Open, 4. Open, 5 Open, 6. Open, 7 Open, 8. Open, 9. Open, 10. Open, 11. Open, 12. Open (12 total stations)
Typical Size: 100-120ft long
Guntor will be joining Nolan and Finn on the #the-golden-voice
